normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists as the destination argument of _transfer and has no independent meaning outside it
The sender parameter is only the debited party of _transfer and should be folded into that core function
The amount parameter is only meaningful in the fee/transfer arithmetic of _transfer
The account parameter only identifies the dividend recipient handled by processAccount
The contractTokenBalance local is a transient snapshot consumed solely by _executeSwap
The senderBalance local is a transient cache used only inside _executeTransfer
The bps parameter is only validated and written by setMaxTxBPS
